# Not in the backup: re-download after a restore

desktop, recorded 2026-10-01. These were left out on purpose: they re-download themselves or already live somewhere else. Your settings for all of them *are* backed up.

## Steam games: 2, 45.0 GB

Steam downloads them again when you install them from your library.

- Example Quest (40.0 GB, appid 100)
- Example Racer (5.0 GB, appid 200)

- **Rust toolchains** (version stable), 1.2 GB: rustup downloads them again.
  `~/.rustup`
- **Browser caches**, 300.0 MB: they fill up again by themselves.
  `~/.cache/example-browser`
